title: In the town hall meeting it was explained that ETH Zurich plans to shape its forms of work and collaboration in two phases: "Return to the Office" and "Future of Work". In addition, the Vice-Presidency for Personnel Development and Leadership presented the "Welcome Back" workshop .
main_content:
Main article: In the town hall meeting it was explained that ETH Zurich plans to shape its forms of work and collaboration in two phases: "Return to the Office" and "Future of Work". In addition, the Vice-Presidency for Personnel Development and Leadership presented the "Welcome Back" workshop .

This voluntary workshop can be used by supervisors to identify individual as well as collective team needs in the area of flexible working in order to find a solution tailored to the team's working patterns and collaboration.

Now you can find various FAQs about flexible working, working from home as well as mobile working on the website Flexible Working - FAQs | ETH Zürich .
